title: Tech-Avishkar 24 Hour Hackathon
content:
On the occasion of IEEE Mysore Subsection Foundation Day, IEEE Mysore Subsection is organizing Tech-Avishkar 24 Hour Hackathon in association with IEEE Bangalore Section, co-organized and hosted at ATME College of Engineering in association with CSI Student Branch Chapter on 21st -22nd December 2022.

Kindly share this with your friends, connections, and Students and register to this event.

Themes for Hackathon
1) Agricultural and Rural Development
2) Assisting device or application for physically challenged
3) Development of an android App to implement desi games
4) Green Environment
5)Renewable energy sources
6) IoT enabled Smart cities
7)Health care for the Elders
8)Home Automation
9) Development of an android app for learning local languages
10) Development of an Android app for practicing yoga and pranayama

Registration Details

1) Registration fee is Rs. 500/- per team.
2) Team size: 3 to 4 members.
3) All the team members should be from the same college.
4) No restriction on the number of teams from each college.

Target Participants

UG/ PG Students and Research Scholars

Venue: ATMECE, Mysuru

Note: Participation certificate will be provided to all the Participants
